subject: Consolidate June partial charges into single invoice (legacy -> committed plan)
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@meditech.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: June charges — two invoices? Can we consolidate?

Hi Mina,

Quick one: we upgraded Meditech from a legacy hourly reserved capacity plan to a committed 3-month pool on 2026-06-15 (signed amendment attached on our end). I see two invoices for June: a partial legacy invoice for 06/01–06/14 and a committed-plan pro-rated invoice for 06/15–06/30. Our accounting needs a single invoice for June for VAT reporting and PO reconciliation — can Redwood merge these into one final invoice (apply an internal credit/offset) instead of two separate line items?

We also noticed a small rounding discrepancy (~€13) on the legacy portion likely due to currency conversion. Can finance absorb/offset it into the consolidated invoice?

Cc: Meditech Billing <billing@meditech.io>

Thanks — appreciate the help,
Oliver
Billing Ops
Meditech

Hi Oliver — thanks for the note and congrats on the plan move.

Short answer: yes, we can issue a single consolidated invoice for June that shows the legacy charge, the committed plan credit, and a single VAT total — but we need a signed amendment and the usage export for June to reconcile the hourly legacy run and the committed pool billing. If you can send the signed amendment (or confirm DocuSign ID) and the usage CSV, I'll loop in finance to create the single invoice and apply the offset for the rounding.

Next steps I propose:
- You send the signed amendment or DocuSign reference (if not already done).
- I'll confirm the internal credit and rounding policy with Finance.
- Finance will create a consolidated invoice and post a clearing credit so you receive one PDF invoice for June.

For timing: if we get attachments today, we can have a consolidated invoice issued by EOD 2026-07-01 (US timezone).

Hey team — tagging Finance. A few clarifications from billing ops perspective:

- We can issue a single invoice that consolidates the two periods, but we must keep an auditable line-item history: legacy consumption (prorated days), committed plan prorate, and an "adjustment/credit" line to zero out the duplicate charge. The invoice will still show three entries but will be a single PDF. That should satisfy VAT/PO requirements.
- For VAT treatment: if Meditech is EU-registered and provided a valid VAT ID, we need to ensure the invoice reflects reverse charge (if applicable). If not, we apply local VAT rates — Evelyn, can you confirm EU VAT strategy vs. reverse charge for this account?
- Rounding: we can apply a single rounding offset as an adjustment line; Finance needs approval to absorb small rounding amounts under €50.

Mina — please attach the amendment and usage CSV. Evelyn — if you approve absorbing the €13, confirm and I’ll include it as a one-line discount/credit.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: June charges — two invoices? Can we consolidate?

Hi all — Finance confirms we can proceed with a consolidated invoice PDF for June. Notes: 

- Approval: Finance approves absorbing the €13 rounding discrepancy as a contra-revenue adjustment (approved under the merchant adjustment policy; amount < €50).
- VAT: Meditech is EU-registered with VAT ID provided in the amendment. We will apply reverse charge (no VAT on Redwood's line) and include Meditech's VAT ID on the invoice. Please confirm the VAT ID in the amendment or reply with the exact number; I will redact it from the public copy if requested.
- Accounting entries: We will generate invoice INV-2026-06-1127 (consolidated) and a clearing credit memo CM-2026-06-45 that zeroes the duplicate legacy invoice. Both documents will be linked and included in the PDF bundle.
- Cutoff & timing: We will post the consolidated invoice today and send to billing@meditech.io by 17:00 UTC. Payment terms remain NET-30 from the consolidated invoice date.

Attachments requested: signed amendment (pdf) and usage-export-June-2026.csv — Mina, can you upload to the secure link or reply-all with the pdf?

Regards,
